from pathlib import Path
import ast

targets = [
    (Path("astropy/io/fits/header.py"), "Header", "fromstring", "data"),
    (Path("astropy/io/fits/card.py"), "Card", "fromstring", "image"),
]

for path, class_name, method_name, argument in targets:
    text = path.read_text()
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    method = None
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == class_name:
            for child in node.body:
                if isinstance(child, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and child.name == method_name:
                    method = child
                    break
    if method is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Could not find {class_name}.{method_name} in {path}")
    segment = ast.get_source_segment(text, method)
    marker = f"isinstance({argument}, bytes)"
    if marker in segment:
        print(f"{path}: bytes handling already present")
        continue
    if not method.body:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{class_name}.{method_name} has no body")
    doc = method.body[0]
    if not (
        isinstance(doc, ast.Expr)
        and isinstance(doc.value, (ast.Str, ast.Constant))
        and isinstance(getattr(doc.value, "s", getattr(doc.value, "value", None)), str)
    ):
        raise RuntimeError(f"{class_name}.{method_name} has no docstring")
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    insertion_index = doc.end_lineno
    indent = " " * (method.col_offset + 4)
    block = (
        f"{indent}if isinstance({argument}, bytes):\n"
        f"{indent}    {argument} = {argument}.decode('ascii')\n"
    )
    if insertion_index >= len(lines) or lines[insertion_index].strip():
        block += "\n"
    lines.insert(insertion_index, block)
    path.write_text("".join(lines))
    print(f"{path}: added bytes decoding to {class_name}.{method_name}")
PY
